privacy.hero.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: pyBIM is committed to respecting user privacy and handling information responsibly in alignment with applicable European data protection principles (GDPR - Regulation EU 2016/679). This document describes how information is handled across our public website, inquiry forms, and ROI calculator tool.
privacy.iubenda.title: Iubenda Hosted Privacy Document
privacy.iubenda.desc: Our standard Privacy Policy is registered and hosted on the Iubenda platform. Under our current free account configuration, full in-page text embedding via JavaScript widget is not supported. The official hosted document is available directly via the link below:
privacy.sec1.title: 1. Data Controller & Inquiries
privacy.sec1.desc: For inquiries regarding data handling on this website:
privacy.sec1.list4: Privacy Inquiries: Contact us at info@pybim.com for questions or data requests.
privacy.sec2.title: 2. Categories of Information Collected
privacy.sec2.desc: We collect and handle information in the following contexts:
privacy.sec2.item1.title: Information Submitted Voluntarily by the User:
privacy.sec2.item1.desc: Name, email address, corporate role, project requirements, and technical specifications voluntarily submitted via our Contact, Early Access, or ROI Matrix forms.
privacy.sec2.item2.title: Technical and Security Browsing Data:
privacy.sec2.item2.desc: Technical request parameters including IP address, browser/device characteristics, timestamp, and Cloudflare Turnstile verification tokens used to safeguard web endpoints against automated abuse.
privacy.sec3.title: 3. Purposes of Processing & ROI Tool Operation
privacy.sec3.desc: Information is handled for specific operational purposes:
privacy.sec3.item1: Responding to technical inquiries, project evaluations, and quotation requests submitted by users.
privacy.sec3.item2: ROI Matrix Tool Operation: The ROI calculation and Excel (.xlsx) workbook are generated client-side directly within your browser. When you request the download, an automated lead notification containing the estimate parameters is delivered to pyBIM Support to assist with follow-up discussions.
privacy.sec3.item3: Protecting website integrity, preventing automated bot submissions, and mitigating denial-of-service attempts (Cloudflare Turnstile).
privacy.sec3.item4: Fulfilling commercial, accounting, and legal requirements where formal bilateral B2B agreements are executed.
privacy.sec4.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
privacy.sec4.desc: Where processing of personal data occurs under EU data protection principles, it relies upon:
privacy.sec4.item1: Pre-contractual communication initiated at the request of the user (e.g. project inquiries or quote requests).
privacy.sec4.item2: Legitimate interests in securing web infrastructure, preventing spam, and managing commercial inquiries.
privacy.sec4.item3: Statutory legal obligations applicable to executed commercial transactions.
privacy.sec5.title: 5. Data Retention
privacy.sec5.desc: We retain submitted information only as long as reasonably necessary for business communications or as required by law:
privacy.sec5.item1: Inquiry Communications: Contact submissions and ROI lead notifications are retained for the duration of technical evaluation and subsequent business discussions, unless deletion is requested.
privacy.sec5.item2: Commercial & Contract Records: B2B client contracts, invoices, and accounting records are preserved in accordance with applicable statutory retention requirements.
privacy.sec5.item3: Client Engineering Deployments: Data retention, model handling, and confidentiality for Sovereign AI and outsourced BIM projects are governed by individual client agreements and NDAs.
privacy.sec6.title: 6. Third-Party Infrastructure and Services
privacy.sec6.desc: pyBIM does not sell or rent personal information to third parties. Public website operations utilize established infrastructure providers:
privacy.sec6.item1: Cloudflare, Inc. — Global edge hosting, content delivery, DDoS protection, and Turnstile privacy-preserving bot verification.
privacy.sec6.item2: Resend, Inc. — Transactional email service used to transmit inbound contact form submissions and ROI lead notifications to pyBIM Support.
privacy.sec6.item3: Iubenda — External hosting platform for privacy and cookie documentation.
privacy.sec7.title: 7. Security Measures
privacy.sec7.desc: We apply technical measures designed to protect information, including modern transport layer encryption (TLS) across web endpoints, structured API input validation, and defensive bot verification. For client Sovereign AI engineering workflows, pyBIM supports air-gapped on-premise execution models designed to operate without outbound telemetry.
privacy.sec8.title: 8. User Rights & Contact
privacy.sec8.desc: Under applicable European data protection principles, users may have rights to:
privacy.sec8.item1: Request access to personal information held about them.
privacy.sec8.item2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
privacy.sec8.item3: Request erasure of personal information or restriction of further communication.
privacy.sec8.item4: Object to legitimate-interest communication or withdraw previous contact consent.
privacy.sec8.contact: To make an inquiry or exercise these rights, please contact our privacy desk at: info@pybim.com.
